description: This file is a shell script for testing Git repository behavior involving ref namespaces, remote pushing, pulling, cloning, and ref hiding mechanisms. It sets up repositories, defines tests, and verifies Git functionalities with different namespace configurations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution of the provided commands.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Performs setup related to timing or test synchronization.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified content.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the output is empty.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for pattern matches in output.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets or deletes configuration options for Git repositories.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Validates that the executed command fails.

pulling from a repository using a ref namespace
